item.title: Trump gets pledges for Gaza reconstruction, troop commitments at inaugural Board of Peace talks
item.description: President Donald Trump announced Thursday at the inaugural Board of Peace meeting that nine members have agreed to pledge $7 billion toward a Gaza relief package and five countries have agreed to deploy troops as part of an international stabilization force for the war-battered Palestinian territory.

item.title: 68 pounds of drugs, guns found in Akron shipping container
item.description: Federal investigators allege a man stored 68 pounds of illegal drugs and firearms in a shipping container parked on Akron's east side.

item.title: Ohio lottery profits fund school budgets, but not all are equal
item.description: If you buy a lottery ticket, you may think it's giving Ohio schools an added boost, but NBC4 Investigates found that's not actually the case.

item.title: Petition aims to repeal Ohio’s updated cannabis laws
item.description: A group called Ohioans for Cannabis Choice is currently trying to repeal Ohio Senate Bill 56, which was signed into law by Gov. Mike DeWine back in December.

item.title: Cavaliers extend win streak to 6 with 112-84 victory over Nets
item.description: Donovan Mitchell scored 17 points, James Harden added 16 and the Cleveland Cavaliers routed the Brooklyn Nets 112-84 on Thursday night to extend their winning streak to a season-high six games.

item.title: Texas dentist accused of operating on 8-year-old patient while intoxicated: Report
item.description: A dentist was arrested this week after investigators said she allegedly operated on a patient while intoxicated.

item.title: I-Team: Defense in Aliza Sherman case withdraws motion
item.description: A defense attorney withdrew a motion asking for modifications to Gregory Moore's $2 million bond.

item.title: FORECAST: Rain showers, wintry mix and snow on the way
item.description: Late tonight into the overnight look for scattered rain showers. Some rain could be heavy with maybe even a rumble of thunder or two.

item.title: Vermilion taking proactive approach to clear ice jams
item.description: While other cities along the Lake Erie coastline are waiting for nature to run its course and clear ice jams blocking rivers across the region, the city of Vermilion is taking a proactive approach.

item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, dies at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.
